title: Slang AI | The AI Superhost for Restaurants
description: Meet Superhost by Slang AI, the most natural voice AI for restaurants. Answer every call, book reservations and help guests 24/7 in 97 languages.
headings: Voice AI answers the phone. Superhost answers the guest.

blocks: Meet the New Slang AI Superhost
Introducing the most natural restaurant caller experience in the world.
Delivers the most natural, capable guest experience in the market today.
Give guests the freedom to interrupt, change their minds, and switch topics just like they would with your best host.
Serve more guests in their preferred language, with Superhost automatically detecting and switching between 97 languages, even mid-call.
Choose from 20 premium voices and custom greetings to deliver a consistent, on-brand experience at every location.
Superhost responds based on your restaurant’s approved information (not open-ended AI guesswork like other voice AI platforms) so guests get consistently accurate answers.
Unlike traditional voice AI, Superhost continuously monitors and reviews of all your calls.

Increase revenue across every restaurant location with AI-powered phone answering and smart reservation management. Our restaurant voice AI automatically answers calls and suggests available reservations at nearby or sister locations when a guest’s first choice is unavailable.
Ensure your frequent diners and VIPs are automatically identified so they can skip the Slang AI Concierge and get routed straight to your staff.
Stay in the Know with Real-Time Alerts
Speed matters. With Slang AI, you’ll get instant alerts for everything from private event inquiries to lost items, delivered straight to your phone, so you’re always on top of guest needs.
Our official integrations provide a seamless end-to-end experience for guests calling your restaurant.
